title: Fraud scoring should catch card velocity
source: Muse experiment 2 (2026-11-03): written for real work on a hot path, not around a planted cost; its latency effect was not measured before the runs
notes: fraud has 1 worker and about 18 calls/s at 18 ms of work (spec.json); its state lives for the whole process, so its cost can grow with time under load
